name: Snowflake
description: Snowflake data platform with REST APIs, SQL API and drivers for managing and querying data.
auth_notes: REST APIs accept key-pair JWT, OAuth tokens or programmatic access tokens, sent in an Authorization Bearer header.
gate_detail: Sources only show a Getting a Trial Account path; a Snowflake account is needed for any credentials. Whether a permanent free plan exists is not stated. No sandbox described.
api_scope: Snowflake REST APIs (e.g. databases under /api/v2), a SQL API, a Catalog SDK, plus connectors, drivers and the Snowflake CLI.
mcp_notes: Sources do not mention an MCP server.
blocker_detail: Requires a Snowflake account; sources only describe a trial, and token or key-pair setup needs account-side configuration.
